Priya: quick sync  GovRetail wants a 6-week on-prem POC in an isolated DC. Constraints: USB-only media, monthly 2hr maintenance windows, signed artifacts only, no model format changes during POC. Need SOW bullets + runbook + security answers by Friday.
Owen: doable. High level: 1) initial full signed USB bootstrap, 2) minibundle deltas for maintenance windows, 3) two dry-run rehearsals before first window.
Leila: runbook bullets: preflight checks (checksum, disk, deps), stop inference svc, apply minibundle, verify signature + kv-cache, smoke test (3 queries), latency check, auto-rollback on failure. Keep each step <30m total.
Owen: packaging: minibundles = tar.gz with manifest.json + layer diffs. Target delta <=200MB. If >200MB require extended window and customer approval. No quantization changes in-POC.
Leila: security Qs to flag for legal: key custody (we require customer-managed KMS or HSM), artifact signing chain, and export-control language. We'll provide signature verification tool.
OpsBot: minibundle built 1780012400; ci/minibuilder v3; sig: sha256:fa7c8...; status: signed.
Priya: action items: Leila drafts runbook + sample commands, Owen prepares minibundle spec and SOW pricing, Legal review for redlines. I'll send a customer note after drafts. :thumbsup:
